devices.title: My devices
devices.intro: Signing in on a new device requires an OTP, and you can be signed in on a limited number of devices at a time. Sign out of devices you no longer use; their downloaded lectures are removed.
devices.unlockHint: Use {method} instead of your password when the app is locked on this device.
devices.confirmMessage: {name} will be signed out at once and its downloaded lectures removed.
